news.title: Oil tankers transiting Strait of Hormuz 'must be very careful,' Iran Foreign Ministry warns
news.description: The price of crude oil has sharply spiked as the Strait of Hormuz has been effectively closed as the United States and Israel wage war on Iran.

news.title: There's another energy market that may get hit harder than oil by Strait of Hormuz closure
news.description: Roughly 20% of global LNG flows through the Strait.

news.title: U.S. oil closes slightly higher near $95 per barrel after spiking as high as $119 earlier in session
news.description: Gulf Arab oil producers are cutting production as they run out of storage space because they can't export through the Strait of Hormuz
